_source: OSRS Wiki: Keldagrim_minecart_system, Cart_conductor; the conductors' transcripts (data/definitions/npc-dialogues.json). Track 4 and the riding stance are the user's rsprox capture BetweenARock (rev 242.1). Other tiles, steps, ticks and messages are rsprox.net recordings 423 (rev 232: the Grand Exchange trapdoor, talked to and travelled), 3241 (rev 233: a ticket at Ice Mountain and its refusals, Ice Mountain to Keldagrim, Keldagrim to the Grand Exchange and to Ice Mountain, the wrong-ticket and front-of-queue refusals) and 3250 (rev 233: White Wolf Mountain to Keldagrim). Ids are cache gamevals.
_sales: The line each conductor says as a purchase goes through: the coins are taken and the ticket given there. The Tickets option's menus have no such line; their pick is the sale, at the price it shows.

sales.text: Thanks, carts to Ice Mountain depart from track 1.
You're alright, I suppose... I can let you go for 75 coins. And remember, carts to Ice Mountain depart from track 1.
Thanks. Go to track 4 for carts heading to White Wolf Mountain.
You're a decent human, I suppose... I can let you go for 50 coins. Go to track 4 for the carts heading to White Wolf Mountain.
Thanksh a lot human! Remember to come back for more shtout whenever you want! *hic*
Errr... yesh, I shuppose you're right.

_hub: Keldagrim Carts' station. Its carts (keldagrim_train_cart) are not in the map: the recordings add them as the station loads. Each track's front cart is the one to ride; the transcript names the tracks (Ice Mountain track 1, White Wolf Mountain track 4, the Grand Exchange track 3). The fourth row leads to a closed tunnel.
_tracks: Steps count from boarding: [tick, the tile the player is on after it, the glide [from x, from y, start cycle, to x, to y, end cycle, angle]]. Then the fade, the destination and the screen back. Track 4 (White Wolf Mountain) runs east and then south, as the user's Between a Rock capture rides it.

tracks._recorded: the user's rsprox capture BetweenARock (rev 242.1), ticks 725-753 (and the same ride at 2481-2500, 6208-6227)

_refusals: The Ice Mountain pick's refusals, which the Tickets menus' other picks repeat ("Same as ...").

refusals.coins: I'm sorry, I've run out of money.
refusals.space: I'm sorry, [sir/madam], but I don't believe you can hold the ticket.

_outstations: Their carts are in the map; each needs its ticket to Keldagrim. The Grand Exchange trapdoor's ride is free.
_arrival: Into Keldagrim, counting from the fade (the click, or the trapdoor's last line): the worn view blanked at 4, on the station's track at 3, gliding west along it from 5 (the screen back then), off the cart at 22 with the overlay closed and an unridable cart left behind.
_wornHidden: Worn slots the client shows empty while riding (weapon, shield, boots), as recorded; the appearance's stance is human_minecart_anim on all seven slots meanwhile (BetweenARock ticks 725-744, 772-790), which draws the rider in a cart.
_ridingKits: The cart itself is the feet identity kit: 82 in place of the player's own (42) for the whole ride (BetweenARock ticks 725-744, the appearance's identkit block); 83 is the female body's (bodypart 13, model 7118 beside 82's 7117; cache idk dump, Joshua-F/osrs-dumps 853150e).

messages.front: You should take the cart at the front of the queue.
messages.wrongTicket: You don't have an appropriate ticket for these carts.
messages.noTicket: You must purchase a ticket to Keldagrim before you can ride the mine cart.
messages.giantDwarf: You need to start The Giant Dwarf to enter Keldagrim.
messages._giantDwarf: Calibrated: Keldagrim.plugin.js's line for the city's gate; no recording shows a ride refused for the quest.
